propositions: s3_doctor._git invokes gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrappers, while all other store write paths route through gitutil.run_git_write and self-heal transient read faults

The 'fatal: bad object HEAD' error is git reporting an unreadable/absent object (not a corrupt or unborn ref), proven by experiment and reproduced by making the merge commit's loose object unreadable before the bundle call
Three CI test failures across distinct sibling tests (runs 31340000912, 31349549323, 31558315198) fail identically with this signature, while local reproduction over 27 runs yields zero failures

s3_doctor should route through run_git_write to inherit the per-store advisory git-op lock, bounded index/ref-lock retry, and transient read-fault retry, and the missing-object signature should be added to the transient marker family
